title: Solve the Equation
description: Parse and solve a linear equation for x.
pseudocode:
1. Split equation by '=' into left and right sides.
2. Parse both sides to calculate coefficient of x (cx) and constant sum (cn).
3. Move all terms to one side: (cx1 - cx2)x = (cn2 - cn1).
4. If cx == 0 and cn == 0 return 'Infinite solutions', else if cx == 0 return 'No solution'.
5. Return 'x=' + (cn / cx).

steps.note: Parse left side: x+5-3+x -> cx=2, cn=2.
